name: hint-reveal
title: Hint / Reveal
description: RF-6 progressive Hint, standalone Reveal, and HintReveal alias. Hints, solution and feedback are conditionally mounted only after explicit learner requests, never merely hidden in the DOM. Includes controlled/uncontrolled disclosure state, callbacks, localized functional labels, partial streaming content, explicit pending state, keyboard/ARIA semantics and reduced-motion-safe token styling.
